fields.statement: QA cycle 1, scratch root with fake rex/claude and the branch's build (go build -trimpath to a scratch path): started rhiza daemon --permission-mode manual with a user guide at version 0.0.9 missing rhiza-verifier and an untracked project guide missing rhiza-builder; the daemon logged 'refreshed the user guide ... to <version>' and 'refreshed the project repo guide ...' before any run, both installs were back at the running version with the skills present. With the project guide committed (git add -f .claude) and stale, the daemon logged 'could not refresh the project repo guide ...: the guide is committed in the repo: refresh it with rhiza guide install --agent claude --project and commit it through a change set', left the files unchanged and git status --porcelain empty. A foreign rhiza folder (no plugin manifest) was not treated as a guide. go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... -run DaemonGuideRefresh passed.

QA cycle 1, scratch root: an accepted change set, the user guide missing rhiza-builder and made read-only; rhiza daemon --autonomous logged 'could not refresh the user guide ...: permission denied', started no run (runs folder count unchanged), daemon status showed the change set skipped with reason guide-stale ('workflow ship-change starts /rhiza-builder, missing from the installed guide', the error, rhiza guide install --agent claude), and rhiza inbox held one guide-stale item naming the scope, the error and the command. After chmod u+w, the next daemon start refreshed the guide, started the ship-change run (builder launched as attempt 1) and the guide-stale item was gone. A committed stale project guide (no user guide) held the step with an item naming rhiza guide install --agent claude --project and the commit-through-a-change-set text. go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... -run DaemonGuideHold passed.

QA cycle 1, scratch HOME and project with the branch's build: rhiza health --json gave guide ok '0 installed guide(s) current' with no guide, ok '1 installed guide(s) current' after guide install; warn naming the user guide and next rhiza guide install --agent claude with skills/rhiza-builder removed and with version 0.0.9 ('version 0.0.9 is not <version>'); warn with next rhiza guide install --agent claude --project for a stale project guide; a foreign rhiza folder counted as no guide (ok). Human output lists guide right after usage; with only warns, rhiza health exited 0. go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... -run HealthGuide and TestScripts/describe-golden passed.

QA cycle 1, scratch root with fake rex/claude: rhiza run start --foreground --workflow build (builder prompt /rhiza-builder) with HOME's guide lacking rhiza-builder failed at once with 'start command /rhiza-builder unknown to claude: skill not installed; run rhiza guide install --agent claude', no rex call, no session; inbox named the command and rhiza run resume --retry. Two further resumes failed the same way with no attempt used and one inbox item; after rhiza guide install --agent claude, resume --retry launched the builder as attempt 1 (fake builder logged 'beta 1') and cleared the inbox. A non-slash verifier prompt launched normally. go test -trimpath ./internal/adapter/... and TestScripts/run-start-skill-missing passed. One defect recorded as a finding: a marketplace-plugin command is falsely refused.

QA cycle 1, scratch root with an asynchronous fake rex and a fake claude that runs the session's own SessionStart hook command (rhiza session hook SessionStart) with RHIZA_TEST_NOW back-dated past the 3-minute grace and then stays alive without UserPromptSubmit: rhiza run start --foreground failed the builder session at once with 'start command was never submitted', run status showed attempts [] (no attempt used), inbox held the failed run with next rhiza run resume --retry; resume --retry with a working fake builder launched attempt 1 and succeeded, inbox empty. go test -trimpath ./internal/session/... ./internal/api/... -run StartNotSubmitted passed (prompted and within-grace cases not failed).
